_comment: Built-in component names for LabVIEW MeasureData flavors. See src/lvkit/measure_data.py. A MeasureData value is an OPAQUE VCTP leaf -- its component fields are NOT serialized in the VI, so these names come from this table, keyed by the type's exact MEASURE_DATA_FLAVOR name (the string pylabview writes to the extracted XML's <Flavor>). Clean-room: the component names/order are the PUBLIC LabVIEW waveform/digital-data components (NI 'Get Waveform Components' docs), never licensed source. Field indices are the node's stored field index; gaps (e.g. the analog waveform's error cluster at 3-6) are internal fields that aren't user-extractable components. Flavors with no documented named components (TimeStamp, Dynamicdata) are intentionally absent -> resolve to None.
